dct_title_s: Kachin State and Sagaing Region Forest Cover Change
dct_description_sm: Geotiff download link : http://bit.ly/2VOvrlD Metadata Download link: http://geonode.themimu.info/documents/27 A Landsat-based classification of forest cover in Kachin State and Sagaing Region with a focus on changes in intact forest between 2002 and 2014. This dataset expands upon the Myanmar 2002-2014 Forest Cover Change raster*, by differentiating mining from other non-forest land cover classes. Developed by: ALARM, Smithsonian Institution, GMAP and American Museum of Natural History *http://geonode.themimu.info/layers/geonode%3Amyanmar_forestcoverchange See the recommended style file (.txt) in the documents section for associating raster values and creating the legend. Original dataset title: Kachin State and Sagaing Region 2002-2014 Forest Cover Change
